title: finding(spec,i18n): `translateObject` never reads an object's embedded `listViews`, so their labels are served in the authored language while `os i18n extract` writes `_views` keys for them
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect, class (b), a seam where the platform's stated contract is not delivered. `reach:` a named real producer: platform-objects `sys-account.object.ts` embeds `listViews.mine` (label `My Links`), and its `_views` catalog ships in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.objects.generated.ts`. The `/meta/object` HTTP door itself was NOT MEASURED. Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) from objectstack-ai/objectui#11295's dev report (`5922666442`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`), confirmed by PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11303's contract review. ⛔ Not graded here.

Dedup: no hit among the 600 most recently updated objectstack issues and PRs (read through REST, grepped locally) for `translateObject` together with `listViews` translation. The nearest are objectstack-ai/objectstack#20731 (a published org overlay on a packaged **view** label, the `translateView` path) and PRs #20728 / #20770 (dashboard and view catalogs yield to overlays). None names the object-embedded `listViews` channel.

## Measured

- **The translator.** At objectstack `origin/main` `f8178ffece`, `translateObject` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` about `:2790`) translates the object's `label` / `pluralLabel` / `description`, its `fields` (labels and picklist options) and its `actions`. It has **no `listViews` read**.
- **The catalog.** `os i18n extract` (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` about `:72`–`:75`) writes `objects.<name>._views.<view>.label` / `.description` / `emptyState.*` / `bulkActions.*` keys for an object's `listViews`. So the catalog carries translations that the server-side translator never applies.
- **The published translator** (`@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0), measured by the objectui dev: `translateMetadataDocument('object', …)` for `zh-CN` translated `sys_account`'s object label to `账户` and left `listViews.mine.label` as `My Links`.
- **The contract text.** `translateView`'s docblock: "Useful for translating metadata at the API boundary so any client (Studio, app-shell, plain HTTP) receives already-localized labels." That sentence is the **view** translator's; triage judges whether it binds the object-embedded channel.

## Consequence

- A client that reads `/meta/object` and is not the objectui console gets the authored text for these tabs.
- The objectui console still translates them, through its own bundle (`viewLabel`). PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11303 deliberately keeps that path for embedded `listViews`, because the server does not translate them. If this card lands, that console path becomes a second translation pass over a served value. objectui's `useServedViewItems` then needs to count `/meta/object`-embedded views as served (one line, objectui side).

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- `translateObject` translates an object's embedded `listViews` from the `_views` keys `os i18n extract` already writes, with the same override order the view and dashboard catalogs follow since PRs #20728 / #20770.
- Pins: `sys_account`'s `listViews.mine` served in `zh-CN` reads the catalog's translation; an org overlay on it wins (the #20770 order); an object with no `_views` entry is unchanged (the control).
- `Seam:` spec `translateObject` (`objects[].listViews.*.label`) → runtime `translateMetaDocument` on `/meta/object` | renderer: objectui app-shell `ObjectView` tab and `AppHeader` crumb.

Dedupe words: `translateObject listViews` · `object embedded listViews untranslated` · `_views catalog object document` · `meta/object listViews label locale` · `sys_account My Links`
